messages:
maria.partnerships: Quick sync — Snow / Databricks / Qdrant asked for a coordinated marketplace + press window around Sept 14-20. We need a short checklist: legal sign-off, embargo time, staging lab access, telemetry quota, and marketplace manifest + SKU. Who owns press timing?

sam.eng: We can spin up staging by 2024-09-10. Need sample data size + ingest method (S3 vs direct upload). Also, do we want a throttled demo endpoint?

leo-pm: Marketing prefers Sept 16 (Tue) for embargo lift. That gives partners Mon for last-minute checks. Agree with staging on 9/10.

natalie-legal: Need to review sample data for PII and retention rules. Send sample + data retention policy. Also require DPAs for EU partner flows before public listing.

amy-marketing: I can coordinate press kit and partner one-liners. Need partner-approved logos and a single product sentence by Thurs. Also: preferred embargo time 09/16 09:00 PT.

deploy-bot: staging-cluster created: redwood-staging-397654 (owner: sam.eng) — creds posted to #secrets (auto-delete in 7d).

sam.eng: Telemetry default cap we'll set to 1k reqs/s with burst allowance; can tune per-partner. For the demo, suggest 200rps steady, partners asked to limit spikes. @maria.partnerships can you confirm expected demo concurrency?

maria.partnerships: Partners indicated ~200 rps steady; HW partner might spike to 1k during demo. We'll ask them to gate spikes, but plan for auto-throttle.

leo-pm: Quick runbook sketch (for Thurs follow-up):
```
- Legal sign-off (natalie-legal)
- Staging creds + ingest method (sam.eng)
- Telemetry cap config (eng-sre)
- Demo runbook + roles (partners + partner-eng)
- Marketplace manifest & SKU (partnerships)
- Press embargo time (amy-marketing)
```

natalie-legal: I'll review redaction & DPA items by EOD Friday and flag anything blocking. If sample data is synthetic, faster to approve.

amy-marketing: I'll chase partner PRs for logos + one-liners today. Can someone upload a draft press blurb to the drive link?

maria.partnerships: Uploaded draft blurb to the shared drive. Also, need marketplace listing metadata: pricing tier, included features, and support contact. @sam.eng — any special metadata we need in the connector manifest?

sam.eng: Manifest needs: name, version, supported regions, hardware hints (GPU/CPU), and telemetry endpoint. Example snippet: 
```
{
  "name": "redwood-snowbridge-connector",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "regions": ["us-west-2", "eu-west-1"],
  "supported_hardware": ["NVIDIA-A100", "CPU-x86"],
  "telemetry_endpoint": "https://telemetry.redwood.example/v1/ingest"
}
```

maria.partnerships: Perfect. I'll collect partner logos + SKU details. Let's reconvene Thurs 10:00am PT to confirm final checklist and embargo time. I'll send a calendar invite. :calendar:

leo-pm: +1 for Thurs 10am PT.

amy-marketing: +1. I'll bring the press timeline.

natalie-legal: +1. I'll bring DPA / redaction status.

sam.eng: I'll bring staging access details and telemetry knobs.

maria.partnerships: Thanks all — I'll update this thread with any partner replies and the calendar invite.
